en: Background decorations drifting in the activity area (they don't interact with pets or props). “Auto” = appears after 18:00 local time and hides at 06:00 the next day; you can also set the hours yourself, keep them always on, or turn them off entirely. The small area where a firefly is can't be clicked through to the desktop (it's tiny and recovers once it drifts away).

keys: 「一直啟用」= 只有 normal 這個狀態,平時就是它。「指定時間段」與「有桌寵正在做某個動作」= 平時播 normal,條件成立時切到 conditional(例如檯燈的燈亮起來、迪斯可燈開始轉)。這批的條件種類還不多,之後會照積木能用的條件慢慢補。
zh_TW: 「一直啟用」= 只有 normal 這個狀態,平時就是它。「指定時間段」與「有桌寵正在做某個動作」= 平時播 normal,條件成立時切到 conditional(例如檯燈的燈亮起來、迪斯可燈開始轉)。這批的條件種類還不多,之後會照積木能用的條件慢慢補。
en: "Always on" = only the normal state exists, that's how it always looks. "A specified time range" and "A pet is doing a certain action" = plays normal by default, switches to conditional once the condition is met (e.g. a lamp turning on, a disco light starting to spin). There aren't many condition types in this batch yet; more will be added gradually to match what blocks can check.

keys: 固定清單(不能自訂),給網頁端積木編輯器的事件判定篩選用,例如「家具標籤是椅子」;一件家具可以選好幾個,最多 %d 個,不知道選什麼可以先跳過。

en: A fixed list (can't be customized), used by the web block editor's event conditions for filtering, e.g. "furniture tag is chair"; a piece of furniture can have several, up to %d; if you're not sure, feel free to skip this.

keys: 設定好道具跟補滿數量,這件家具就會變成容器:桌寵會自主走過去拿裡面的道具(前提是牠喜歡這個道具、容器還有庫存、桌面上同一種道具還沒到上限),使用者也可以雙擊容器打開查看內容物、按按鈕補滿。沒有設定任何內容物就是普通家具,不會有這個行為;桌寵觸發使用或使用者打開查看時,家具會播「使用中」那個動作槽(interacted,在「編輯素材…」裡準備)。最多 %d 種道具,同一種只能設定一筆(重複新增會改上限,不會變成兩筆)。
zh_TW: 設定好道具跟補滿數量,這件家具就會變成容器:桌寵會自主走過去拿裡面的道具(前提是牠喜歡這個道具、容器還有庫存、桌面上同一種道具還沒到上限),使用者也可以雙擊容器打開查看內容物、按按鈕補滿。沒有設定任何內容物就是普通家具,不會有這個行為;桌寵觸發使用或使用者打開查看時,家具會播「使用中」那個動作槽(interacted,在「編輯素材…」裡準備)。最多 %d 種道具,同一種只能設定一筆(重複新增會改上限,不會變成兩筆)。
en: Set a prop and a refill amount, and this piece of furniture becomes a container: pets will walk over on their own and take the prop inside (as long as they like it, the container has stock, and the amount of that prop already on the desktop is under the cap); the user can also double-click the container to view its contents and refill it with a button. With no contents set it's just ordinary furniture with no such behavior; when a pet triggers use or the user opens to view it, the furniture plays its "in use" action slot (interacted, prepared via "Edit Assets…"). Up to %d kinds of props, one entry per kind (adding it again just updates the amount, it won't create a duplicate entry).

keys: 開精靈圖編輯器的家具區,準備 normal(平時)、conditional(條件成立時)、interacted(以後給桌寵用時)三個動作槽的圖;坐/躺位置(錨點)與光源也在那邊編輯,可以直接在畫布上對著貼圖拖曳,看得到實際位置。

en: Opens the furniture section of the sprite editor, to prepare the normal (default), conditional (when the condition is met), and interacted (for future pet use) action slots; sit/lie positions (anchors) and lights are also edited there, where you can drag directly on the canvas over the sprite to see the real position.

en: {user} in dialogue (see the syntax dictionary) will use whatever's filled in here. You can enter several, separated by commas, and the pet randomly picks one each time it's used. en: For each prop, choose “Likes”, “Dislikes” or “Doesn't interact with this prop” (fully ignores it: doesn't pick it up, doesn't get rubbed by it, doesn't become a candidate, isn't attracted). Props whose data can't be found (deleted or moved) are grayed out, and you can press “Relink…” to point them to another existing prop.

en: When the timeout expires, roll the dice to decide whether to continue for another round (the duration is drawn again from the range above): chance = continue chance × decay per round^(rounds completed − 1), getting lower each round, and it always ends once “Max rounds” is reached (same approach as sleeping's “sleep another round”). Continue chance 0 = never continue. Only takes effect if an auto-timeout is set first.

en: Which state lens the pet enters when mood is high (above the "happy threshold") or low (below the "angry threshold"): specify it here (multiple choices allowed; one of your checked ones is picked at random each time it needs to enter one); if none are checked, one is picked at random among the positive/negative state lenses that have "can be called by mood threshold" checked. Whether a state lens can be called by mood is set in its own checkbox on the "State Lenses" tab. The mood thresholds and swing amount are in the parameters below.

en: Edit the boxes below directly and they apply to this pet right away (remember to press “Save”). Parameters you've changed are kept by default when you switch personalities later. The ↺ at the right of each row returns to the default value. Hover over a name for the full description.

keys: 簡單地告訴桌寵「你會想到、提到哪些事物」,一行一個(最多 %d 個、每個最多 %d 字)。台詞裡寫 {keyword} 就會隨機換成其中一個,例如「%s似乎在想關於 {keyword} 的事情」「你知道關於 {keyword} 的事嗎?」「oO(有點想念 {keyword} 呀…)」;{kw:1}、{kw:2}… 是同一個事件裡各不相同的幾個,適合做「猜猜我現在最想要什麼?」這種四個選項都是答案的題目。庫是空的就用預設詞(可以寫 {keyword|某件事} 自訂)。改了立刻生效,記得按「儲存」。
zh_TW: 簡單地告訴桌寵「你會想到、提到哪些事物」,一行一個(最多 %d 個、每個最多 %d 字)。台詞裡寫 {keyword} 就會隨機換成其中一個,例如「%s似乎在想關於 {keyword} 的事情」「你知道關於 {keyword} 的事嗎?」「oO(有點想念 {keyword} 呀…)」;{kw:1}、{kw:2}… 是同一個事件裡各不相同的幾個,適合做「猜猜我現在最想要什麼?」這種四個選項都是答案的題目。庫是空的就用預設詞(可以寫 {keyword|某件事} 自訂)。改了立刻生效,記得按「儲存」。
en: Simply tell the pet “what things it would think of and mention”, one per line (up to %d entries, each up to %d characters). Writing {keyword} in a line randomly swaps it for one of them, e.g. “%s seems to be thinking about {keyword}”, “Do you know anything about {keyword}?”, “oO(I kind of miss {keyword}...)”; {kw:1}, {kw:2}… are different ones within the same event, good for questions like “Guess what I want most right now?” where all four options are answers. If the pool is empty, default words are used (you can write {keyword|something} to customize). Changes take effect immediately; remember to press “Save”.

keys: {keyword} = 隨機一個;{keyword|某件事} = 庫是空的時顯示「某件事」;{kw:1}~{kw:9} = 這個事件洗牌後的第 N 個(1、2、3、4 各不相同)。點右邊的「語法字典」看全部語法。
zh_TW: {keyword} = 隨機一個;{keyword|某件事} = 庫是空的時顯示「某件事」;{kw:1}~{kw:9} = 這個事件洗牌後的第 N 個(1、2、3、4 各不相同)。點右邊的「語法字典」看全部語法。
en: {keyword} = one at random; {keyword|something} = shows “something” when the pool is empty; {kw:1}~{kw:9} = the Nth after this event's shuffle (1, 2, 3, 4 are all different). Click “Syntax Dictionary” on the right to see all syntax.

en: Which action's assets in the pack this system action (idle, walk...) should use. "Auto" follows the alias rules (if run has no dedicated assets, it borrows from walk — this is the default behavior, and where "run ← walk" in the Action list comes from). "Don't share (leave blank)" explicitly borrows no assets, leaving this action with no dedicated visuals, falling back to the engine's normal degrade rule (e.g. lie falls back to sit if missing, sit falls back to idle if missing). You can also pick any other action in the pack directly to manually specify what to share from. This row only shows when a system-action slot is selected; custom actions don't have this concept.

keys:
播放速度:這個動作每秒播幾幀。循環方式:
・整段循環:從第一幀播到最後一幀,再回到第一幀(預設)。
・從指定幀循環:第一次從第 0 幀播到「循環終點」幀,之後每次都從「循環起點」幀接回來,只在起點~終點之間循環(例如 2~4:0 1 2 3 4 2 3 4 2 3 4…;終點之後的幀不會播)。
・播一次,停在指定幀:播到那一幀就停住,直到動作被切換(例如坐下做好後不再動)。
・循環 N 次:整段動畫重複播 N 次(填 0 = 只播一次、不循環)後停在最後一幀,直到動作被切換;和「播一次,停在指定幀」不同的地方是這個一定播完整段、可以重複好幾輪。
幀編號就是幀清單縮圖上的數字。設定只影響遊戲裡的播放;預覽動畫裡「循環 N 次」為了方便看清楚會一直重複播放,不會自動停(遊戲裡才會真的停)。

en:
Playback speed: how many frames this action plays per second. Loop mode:
・ Loop whole clip: plays from the first frame to the last, then back to the first (default).
・ Loop from a frame: plays from frame 0 to the "loop end" frame the first time, then loops back from the "loop start" frame each time after, only cycling between start and end (e.g. 2~4: 0 1 2 3 4 2 3 4 2 3 4...; frames after the end never play).
・ Play once, hold on a frame: plays until that frame and stops there until the action changes (e.g. stays still once sitting down is done).
・ Loop N times: repeats the whole clip N times (0 = play once, no loop) then holds on the last frame until the action changes; unlike "play once, hold on a frame", this always plays the full clip and can repeat several rounds.
Frame numbers are the numbers shown on the frame thumbnails. This setting only affects in-game playback; in the preview, "loop N times" keeps repeating for easier viewing and won't stop on its own (it only really stops in-game).

Pan view: left-drag pans the view without changing any data (default; middle-button and right-button drags also pan).
Move pivot: changes “which point on the image is the feet”; the hitbox and sitting are both based on it.

In use and Dragging can have a play count, and either “Trigger” (plays that many times on entering the state, then returns to Default) or “Loop” (loops for as long as the state lasts). States with no images don't play; the Default state must have images for the advanced texture to take effect (otherwise the simple-version single image is used).

A state with no image set simply doesn't play; normal must have an image.

en:
Playback speed: how many frames per second this action plays. Loop mode:
・Loop entire sequence: plays from the first frame to the last, then back to the first (default).
・Loop from a chosen frame: the first time plays from frame 0 to the “loop end” frame, and every time after that it jumps back to the “loop start” frame, looping only between start and end (e.g. 2~4: 0 1 2 3 4 2 3 4 2 3 4…; frames after the end are not played).
・Play once, stop at a chosen frame: plays up to that frame and holds until the action is switched (e.g. stays still after finishing a sit-down).
Frame numbers are the numbers on the frame list thumbnails. Settings only affect playback in the game, and the preview animation also plays this way.

en:
Reset this character's “%s”%s to the shared original?
The lines and parameter settings modified for this character will be lost (parameters already applied to the pet won't change; press “Apply” again for the original's values to take effect).

keys: 角色身上的配件:一到多張圖(多張會循環)、錨點(相對腳底軸心、縮放前像素)、圖層、縮放、在哪些動作顯示。種類「配件」會出現在桌寵右鍵選單的「變更配件」(可以個別開關);「眨眼」「說話」是差分:眨眼隨機短暫出現、說話在打字機說話時顯示。上面「模式」選「調整配件位置」可以直接在畫布上拖曳錨點。存檔會寫進素材包的 overlays.json。最多 %d 個。
zh_TW: 角色身上的配件:一到多張圖(多張會循環)、錨點(相對腳底軸心、縮放前像素)、圖層、縮放、在哪些動作顯示。種類「配件」會出現在桌寵右鍵選單的「變更配件」(可以個別開關);「眨眼」「說話」是差分:眨眼隨機短暫出現、說話在打字機說話時顯示。上面「模式」選「調整配件位置」可以直接在畫布上拖曳錨點。存檔會寫進素材包的 overlays.json。最多 %d 個。
en: Accessories on the character: one or more images (multiple loop), anchor (relative to the feet pivot, pre-scale pixels), layer, scale, and which actions it is shown in. The “Accessory” type appears in the pet's right-click menu under “Change accessories” (each can be toggled individually); “Blink” and “Speech” are variants: blink appears briefly at random, speech is shown while the typewriter speaks. After choosing “Adjust accessory position” under “Mode” above, you can drag the anchor directly on the canvas. Saving writes to the asset pack's overlays.json. Up to %d.
